tokens.name: forest-green
tokens.usage: Brand color: the logo and, in light theme, headings and primary buttons. Components use the semantic tokens below, not this one.

tokens.name: sage-green
tokens.usage: Brand color: secondary accents; primary fill in dark theme. The sheet labels it #98C1D9, a blue that does not match its own swatch; this is the swatch's color. 2.0:1 on warm-cream: never text there.

tokens.name: warm-cream
tokens.usage: Brand color: light background; text in dark theme.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Brand color: calls to action in both themes. White text on it is 4.53:1; warm-cream only 4.03:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text in light theme, background in dark theme, and the light logo's wordmark. Not on the sheet: taken from how the sheet renders it.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Light-theme cards and inputs, CTA labels. Not on the sheet: taken from how the sheet renders it.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, dropdowns, menus.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on background and surface (≥13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and placeholders on background and surface (≥5.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings on background and surface (≥8.6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, toggle on, focus ring, selected states.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (≥7.5:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary (≥8.6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary accents: secondary button border, sage toggle, off-toggle edge.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Call-to-action fill, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Text on cta (4.53:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input, dropdown and divider lines. Decorative strength (1.4:1 light, 2.1:1 dark); the field's fill also marks it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: alert/badge text and border, field error text and border, destructive button fill. Text on surface, background and danger-subtle ≥5.7:1 light, ≥5.3:1 dark. Always with an icon or words.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button): 6.5:1 light, 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of danger alerts and badges. Nearly the surface's lightness, so it always comes with a danger border.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and completed states: alert/badge text and border. Text on surface, background and success-subtle ≥6.3:1 light, ≥8.2:1 dark. Always with an icon or words.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts and badges, always with a success border.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Something needs attention but nothing failed: alert/badge text and border. Text on surface, background and warning-subtle ≥6.3:1 light, ≥8.5:1 dark. Always with an icon or words.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts and badges, always with a warning border.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and tips: alert/badge text and border. Text on surface, background and info-subtle ≥5.9:1 light, ≥5.7:1 dark. Always with an icon or words.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of info alerts and badges, always with an info border.
